responsibility: Implements __gnat_runtime_initialize, the runtime-library setup routine called from adainit. It maintains the GNAT runtime reference count, performs one-time host-specific initialization such as floating-point setup, Windows process-list synchronization objects, Unicode/codepage state, command-line expansion and UTF-8 argv reconstruction, and optionally installs synchronous signal handlers. This is the concrete runtime startup path, distinct from initialize.c’s replaceable partition hook.
